newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritian rupee weakens vs dlr, pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritian rupee weakens vs dlr, pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both the dollar and the pound on Thursday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a mean commercial rate of 20.1365 against the dollar from 20.0985 on Wednesday, and at 32.210 for one pound from 32.0205.
"The market is short, this is why the mauritian rupee started weakening," one dealer said.
Forex dealers said many commercial banks had a shortage of hard currency position but the central bank had not intervened.
